'''Chapter 128''' is titled "Pride (Pirate Flag)".

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page#Color Spread|Color Spread]]: "Stand up—if ya wanna fight."

The [[Straw Hat Pirates]] (including [[Nefertari Vivi|Vivi]] and [[Karoo]]) soar the skies on a flock of pterodactyls.

==Short Summary==
The Straw Hats depart from [[Little Garden]], and hurry to [[Arabasta]]. As Smoker intercepts their phone call and leaves for Arabasta as well.

==Long Summary==
On a [[Marine Ships#Smoker's Ship|marine ship]] somewhere in the [[Grand Line]] [[Smoker]] asks an unknown marine to play back the intercepted message that they just recorded. He also demands that [[Tashigi]] hears it as well. Smoker has to shout at her to get her to listen. The message is played back and though it is poor reception a few important words can be heard, such as: princess [[Nefertari Vivi|Vivi]], [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hat]], Mr. 0, and orders. Tashigi then wonders if the message has something to do with Mr. 11, whom Smoker tricks into revealing that he is a part of it.

Smoker then recalls that Vivi is the princess of [[Arabasta]] and decides to head there. Meanwhile back at [[Little Garden]], everyone is happy that they managed to defeat the Baroque Works members, [[Sanji]] then shows up and reveals that he just had a conversation with Mr. 0 and obtained an eternal log pose. Sanji and [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] then try and determine who won their hunting contest which reminds the [[giants]] why they started fighting.

The Straw Hats then leave for Arabasta and the giants tell them no matter what, just go straight.

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Smoker]] has captured [[Mr. 11]].
*[[Nami]] is bitten by [[Animal Species/Arabasta Saga#Kestia|a certain bug]].
*The [[Straw Hat Pirates]] prepare to leave [[Little Garden]].
*[[Den Den Mushi#Black Den Den Mushi|Black Den Den Mushi]] are used by the Marines as a means to spy.
